faq.title: What people ask most often
faq.lead: Still unanswered? Send an e-mail and we will reply during opening hours.

inspection.q: What exactly is checked on a pre-owned unit?
inspection.a: The inspection covers the engine (compression, leaks, noise), chassis and running gear, electrics including an ECU fault-code read-out, the brake system, tyres, and the completeness of the documents. We show you the summary before you decide, including the parts that need attention.

documents.q: What about registration, ownership book and road tax?
documents.a: Every pre-owned unit lists its road-tax validity on its page. The ownership book and registration are checked for authenticity and for a match between their numbers and the machine itself. Ownership transfer and tax renewal can be handled for you, at a cost quoted beforehand.

testRide.q: Can I take a test ride?
testRide.a: For pre-owned units we run the engine up to temperature and inspect it together in the showroom area. A road test depends on the unit, its documents and your licence, so please raise it by e-mail first.

financing.a: We can refer you to third-party finance companies. The estimator on each unit page uses the flat-rate method and is illustrative only: the rate, fees and final approval are decided by the finance company after they review your documents.

delivery.q: Do you deliver to other cities?
delivery.a: Yes. Delivery uses an enclosed trailer, and the cost is calculated from distance and the number of units. You get the estimate before the agreement, not after payment.

tradeIn.a: We consider trade-ins on sportbikes. E-mail photos, mileage, year and documents; the final valuation happens after a physical inspection.

warranty.a: New units carry the official importer's warranty on the manufacturer's terms. Pre-owned units have no factory warranty; what we offer instead is full disclosure of the inspection findings and the chance to examine the bike before buying.

foreignBuyer.q: I am outside Jakarta or abroad — how does it work?
foreignBuyer.a: We can e-mail a walk-around video along with detailed photos and the inspection findings. Payment and delivery are arranged in stages, and every agreement stays in writing.

meta.title: About OKTAN
meta.description: The story behind OKTAN: a demonstration showroom for new and pre-owned sportbikes built on documented inspections and open pricing.

hero.title: A sportbike dealer that answers the hard questions
hero.lead: We were built on a simple habit: name the faults first, talk about price second.

intro.p1: OKTAN started in a small garage that held more spanners than motorcycles. The habit back then was simple: strip whatever looked doubtful on every bike that came in, then write down what needed replacing. Those notes became the inspection standard we still use.
intro.p2: Indonesia's sportbike market has a recurring problem: great photos, vague history. We chose the slower but clearer route — if a machine's past cannot be explained, we do not list it, however attractive the asking price.
intro.p3: This site itself is a technical demonstration: the units, prices and histories on these pages are sample data, and the photography comes from freely licensed collections. The structure, the buying flow and the way information is written are the serious part.

transparency.title: Faults get named first.
transparency.body: Scuffs, replaced parts or overdue services are disclosed before price comes up.

condition.title: Condition is measured, not guessed.
condition.body: Pad thickness, tyre depth and leaks are checked with tools and the results written down.

documents.title: Complete papers or no sale.

noPressure.title: No manufactured urgency.

meta.title: Compliance & disclosure
meta.description: A full account of what the OKTAN site is, where its data and photography come from, and which Indonesian consumer rules apply to motorcycle sales.

hero.title: What you should know about this site
hero.lead: This page explains the site's status, where its data comes from, where its photos come from, and the rules we work to.

compliance.banner: This site is a web design and engineering demonstration. OKTAN is not a registered business, the catalogue is not real stock, and no transaction can be completed through this site.

sections.heading: Site status and identity
body: OKTAN Superbike Gallery is a placeholder brand name created for a portfolio demonstration. The name, logo, address, opening hours and founding year on this site are part of a sample scenario, not the details of a registered company.

That is why the site carries no business licence number, tax number or trade registration. Before any real commercial use, every legal identity detail must be replaced with accurate, verifiable information.

sections.heading: Unit and pricing data
body: The twelve units in the catalogue are sample data. Prices, mileage, number of keepers, service history and road-tax validity are plausible illustrative figures for the Indonesian market, but they do not refer to any specific motorcycle that is actually for sale.

Performance specifications (power, torque, displacement, weight) follow the manufacturers' published figures and have been rounded. Weights use the kerb figure where available. For a real transaction, every number must be verified against the physical unit and its documents.

Vehicle marques and model names mentioned here are the trademarks of their respective owners. They are used descriptively to identify the type of machine, and imply no dealership, affiliation or endorsement by the manufacturers.

sections.heading: Photography sources and licences
body: All motorcycle and atmosphere photography on this site comes from Wikimedia Commons and is used under its licences: CC0, public domain, CC BY or CC BY-SA. These photos are not shoots of units for sale.

The CC BY and CC BY-SA licences require the author and licence to be named. Per-file attribution is published on the Photo credits page, and that attribution file is generated by the asset script so it can never fall behind the images actually shipped.
For genuine commercial use we recommend replacing every photo with your own unit photography, so both the look and the licensing obligations stay fully under your control.

sections.heading: The instalment estimator is not a credit offer
body: The calculator on each unit page uses the flat-rate method with the fixed assumed rate shown on screen. The result is a rough estimate to help frame an early conversation.

It is not a credit offer, not a financing approval, and it excludes administration fees, insurance, provisioning, late-payment penalties and risk assessment. The real scheme is set by a licensed finance company after a formal application.

sections.heading: Contact channel and communication
body: E-mail is the only contact channel on this site. No telephone or WhatsApp number is published, so no personal number is exposed on a public page or inside the source code.

Every enquiry button, comparison action and the contact form work the same way: they compose an e-mail draft containing the unit details and its page link, then open it in your own mail app. Nothing is sent to our servers, and no message leaves your device until you press send.
For a real deployment, a business telephone number and its service hours should be published alongside the e-mail address so buyers have more than one way to reach you.

sections.heading: Consumer protection
body: Selling motor vehicles to consumers in Indonesia is governed by Law No. 8 of 1999 on Consumer Protection, which includes the duty to give correct, clear and honest information about a product's condition and a prohibition on misleading advertising.

Accordingly, condition information on a real listing must disclose defects or important notes known to the seller, not only the favourable side. This demonstration site states that recommendation explicitly so nothing here reads as a claim of perfect condition.
New units follow the official importer's warranty terms. Pre-owned units carry no factory warranty, and that must be stated plainly before any agreement.

sections.heading: Documents, road tax and ownership transfer
body: Vehicle ownership in Indonesia is evidenced by the BPKB ownership book and the STNK registration. Any real transaction must include checking that the frame and engine numbers match the documents, plus the road-tax and blocking status.

Transfer fees, title-change duties and tax renewal follow the tariffs applicable in each region. Cost estimates should be given in writing before an agreement so they never appear as an unagreed extra.

sections.heading: Riding safety
body: Large-capacity sportbikes demand experience, protective equipment and the correct licence. We do not publish content that encourages excessive speed or riding on public roads beyond legal limits.
Atmosphere photography showing a rider leaning into a corner comes from freely licensed collections and is not intended as an invitation to repeat similar manoeuvres on public roads.

sections.heading: Accessibility and technology
body: This site targets WCAG 2.1 level AA: sufficient text contrast, a visible focus order, ARIA labelling on interactive components, and respect for the prefers-reduced-motion setting.

The 3D showpiece on the home page is an optional enhancement. If the browser lacks WebGL, if it errors, or if the visitor asks for reduced motion, the site falls back to a static photo without losing any information.
If you hit an accessibility barrier, please tell us through the contact channels. We treat accessibility fixes as defect fixes, not feature requests.

sections.heading: Updates to this page
body: Whenever a feature, a data set or a third-party asset changes, this page and the project documentation are updated in the same change. The date at the top of the page shows the last revision.
If any part of this reads as unclear or potentially misleading, we want to hear it. A correction is better than a claim nobody can stand behind.

meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: What the OKTAN site stores, what it does not store, and how the contact form works without sending data to a server.

hero.title: Very little data, all of it explained
hero.lead: This site runs no analytics, sets no tracking pixels, and never stores what you type into the form.

sections.heading: Summary
body: This is a static site with no visitor database. We do not install Google Analytics, social media pixels or third-party tracking scripts.
Two things are stored in your browser: one language-preference cookie, and one localStorage entry holding the units you flagged for comparison. Both stay on your device.

sections.heading: Language cookie
body: When you switch between Bahasa Indonesia and English, that choice is stored in a cookie called i18n_locale so your next visit opens in the same language.
The cookie is functional, contains no identity information, and is not shared with anyone. You can delete it at any time from your browser settings.

sections.heading: Comparison list
body: Units you flag for comparison are stored in localStorage under the key oktan.compare, purely so your selection survives a page reload.
This data is never transmitted anywhere. Pressing Clear in the comparison tray removes it.

sections.heading: Contact form
body: The form on the Contact page does not send data to our servers, because this site has no receiving endpoint. Your input is used to compose message text, which then opens as a draft in the mail app on your device.
In other words, nothing moves until you press send in that app yourself. Once the e-mail is sent, it sits in our inbox and is governed by the respective mail providers’ policies.

sections.heading: Third-party services
body: Font files are loaded from Google Fonts, so your IP address is visible to that service while the fonts download. All other photos, scripts and styles are served from this site’s own domain.

Map links point to Google Maps, and e-mail links open the mail app on your device. We deliberately embed no maps, videos or chat widgets in the pages, so no third-party cookies are set without your knowledge.

sections.heading: Server logs
body: The hosting provider may keep standard technical logs such as IP address, access time and user agent for security and maintenance. We do not use those logs to build marketing profiles.
For a real deployment, the hosting provider in use should be named on this page together with where the data is stored.

sections.heading: Your rights and contact
body: Because we hold no personal data server-side, there is no archive to request or erase. If you have e-mailed us, you can ask us to delete that message from our inbox.
Privacy questions can be sent to the e-mail address listed on the Contact page.

meta.title: Terms of use
meta.description: Terms of use for the OKTAN site: the status of listings, how prices are quoted, limits of liability, and governing law.

hero.title: The ground rules for using this site
hero.lead: Short, and without language designed to obscure the point.

sections.heading: Acceptance
body: By using this site you are taken to have read and accepted the terms on this page, along with the statements on the Compliance page and in the Privacy policy.
If you do not agree with any part of them, please stop using the site.

sections.heading: Nature of the listings
body: The catalogue on this site contains sample data for demonstration purposes. Even in a real deployment, a vehicle listing is an invitation to discuss, not a legally binding offer.
A sale is only formed after the unit has been inspected, the final price agreed, and both sides have confirmed in writing.

sections.heading: Prices and fees
body: Prices are shown in Rupiah for a single unit and exclude ownership transfer, title-change duty, road-tax renewal, insurance, accessories and delivery unless stated otherwise.
Prices may change without prior notice. The figure that applies is the one confirmed in writing in the conversation before payment.

sections.heading: Availability
body: Availability on this demonstration site is static. In a real deployment, a unit can sell through another channel before its page is updated.
Availability should therefore always be confirmed in conversation before you travel or pay.

sections.heading: Content and intellectual property
body: The text, layout and code of this site were produced for portfolio purposes. The photography comes from third parties under free licences and is credited on the Photo credits page as those licences require.
Vehicle marques and model names belong to their respective owners and are used descriptively, without implying affiliation.

sections.heading: Limits of liability
body: This site is provided as is. We work to keep the information accurate but do not warrant that every specification, availability status or cost estimate is free of error.
A vehicle purchase decision should rest on physical inspection, document verification and, where useful, an independent third-party assessment — not on a web page alone.

sections.heading: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. For a real deployment, dispute resolution and court jurisdiction need to be stated specifically.
Changes to these terms will appear on this page with a new revision date.

ducati-panigale-v4r.tagline: A 998 cc race-homologation engine that revs higher than anything else in its class.
ducati-panigale-v4r.description: The Panigale V4 R is Ducati's homologation build for Superbike racing: displacement is dropped to 998 cc so the engine can rev harder, with a chassis and aerodynamics shaped around track requirements. This sample unit shows low mileage and a complete service book, which suits a collector or scheduled track use. Note that the R's engine service intervals are stricter than a standard Panigale's, and parts pricing follows that character.

bmw-s1000rr.tagline: An inline-four supersport with the most cooperative electronics package in the class.
bmw-s1000rr.description: The S 1000 RR is known for making a very large output feel manageable, thanks to ride modes, IMU-based traction control and an up/down quickshifter. This new unit comes with the official importer's warranty and factory-standard equipment. For a rider who wants a track-capable machine without giving up road usability, this model is usually where the conversation starts.

honda-cbr1000rr-r-sp.tagline: The SP version, with semi-active Öhlins suspension and Grand Prix colours.
honda-cbr1000rr-r-sp.description: The Fireblade SP takes the CBR1000RR-R and adds electronically controlled Öhlins suspension and stronger brakes, a package shaped by Honda's racing programme. This sample unit shows moderate mileage, a complete service history and road tax with plenty of time left. Its engine character rewards high revs, so riders who spend most of their time in traffic often end up happier on a naked bike.

yamaha-yzf-r1.tagline: The 2015-onward crossplane generation, with a sound of its own.
yamaha-yzf-r1.description: This generation of R1 uses the crossplane engine, which makes power delivery feel more progressive and gives it a voice distinct from a conventional inline four. The sample unit has covered a reasonable distance for its age, with partial service history and new tyres fitted. A compelling option for anyone who wants big supersport performance well below current-model money, provided a maintenance budget is set aside.

kawasaki-ninja-zx10r.tagline: Kawasaki's Superbike basis, with a chassis that stays composed at speed.
kawasaki-ninja-zx10r.description: The ZX-10R is built around Superbike racing requirements, and it shows in chassis stability and brakes that stay consistent when hot. This sample unit is a first-owner bike with a complete service book and road tax valid well ahead. Its ergonomics are friendlier than some rivals for road use, though the riding position is still very much supersport.

aprilia-rsv4-rr.tagline: Noale's compact V4, one of the most praised chassis in the supersport class.
aprilia-rsv4-rr.description: The RSV4 uses a narrow V4 that lets the chassis be built very short and quick to change direction. This sample unit has covered a fair distance with partial service history, and comes with an Akrapovič exhaust and frame sliders fitted. For riders who prioritise chassis feel and V4 sound, a machine like this offers something an inline four cannot easily replicate.

ktm-1290-super-duke-r.tagline: A 1301 cc V-twin naked bike with heavy torque from low revs.
ktm-1290-super-duke-r.description: The Super Duke R uses the LC8 V-twin, which produces strong torque from low in the range and makes the bike feel fast without chasing high revs. This sample unit is a first-owner machine with a complete service book. Its character suits winding roads and everyday use, though rear tyres tend to wear faster than on smaller-capacity bikes.

yamaha-mt09.tagline: An 890 cc triple that sets the benchmark for middleweight nakeds.
yamaha-mt09.description: The MT-09 pairs a strong mid-range triple with low weight and an electronics package that now includes cornering ABS and a quickshifter. This new unit comes with the official importer's warranty. For riders stepping up from a 250–650 cc machine, it is often the easiest jump to make without feeling like too much bike.

mv-agusta-brutale-1000-rs.tagline: A four-cylinder naked from Varese, with detailing you do not see elsewhere.
mv-agusta-brutale-1000-rs.description: The Brutale 1000 RS combines a high-output inline four with the finishing detail and four-outlet exhaust that define MV Agusta. This new unit comes with the official importer's warranty and factory-standard equipment. Worth weighing: MV Agusta's service network is smaller than the Japanese marques', so a maintenance plan is best discussed up front.

triumph-street-triple-r.tagline: A 675 cc triple, a sensible entry point into European sportbikes.
triumph-street-triple-r.description: The Street Triple 675 is known for being light, easy to place and blessed with a distinctive triple soundtrack. This sample unit has high mileage, three previous keepers and partial service history, which is why it is the most affordable machine in this catalogue. We state that plainly: a bike like this is enjoyable every day, as long as routine maintenance is budgeted for.

kawasaki-z900rs.tagline: Classic looks with a modern 948 cc engine and approachable handling.
kawasaki-z900rs.description: The Z900RS borrows the design language of the 1972 Z1 and pairs it with a modern 948 cc engine tuned deliberately for smoother delivery. This sample unit is a first-owner bike with original paint, a complete service book and road tax valid well ahead. It suits riders who want the retro look without compromising day-to-day reliability.

ducati-multistrada-v4s.tagline: A V4 sport tourer with semi-active suspension and adaptive cruise control.
ducati-multistrada-v4s.description: The Multistrada V4 S is built for distance without abandoning sporting character: a high-output V4, semi-active suspension and rider aids including radar-based adaptive cruise control. This new unit comes with the official importer's warranty. It is the heaviest machine in this catalogue, so it suits loaded touring rather than darting through city traffic.
